evidence: Authored for this product: every public and grader surface is HireOps-specific. instruction.md:1 'Can you build HireOps, the workspace our recruiting team lives in all day?'; hireops_rules.md defines product-specific roles (Recruiter / Hiring manager / Observer / Candidate, :14-19), six stages with Rejected off to the side (:42-43), manual in-stage order (:57-59), per-job interview places 1-50 (:28, :63-65), versioned stale-move 409 naming the colleague (:77-80), bulk move in board order (:89-92), single-step undo with conflict rules (:96-100), live updates preserving typing/focus/open card/scroll (:117-123), conversations with 30-message paging that preserves place (:144-147), per-person unread and seen semantics where observer opening never counts (:151-166), per-person per-browser drafts surviving sign-out (:170-175) and candidate wording table plus staff-data redaction (:183-194). Seed has jobs Platform Engineer / Data Analyst / Product Designer, 16 applications, 127 messages, read markers and candidate_status_labels; app_context.md names HireOps and its 10 accounts; all 57 criterion ids carry the hro_ prefix and the functional protocols (Z,S,M,L,C,B,N,T,U,K,R,V,A,D) exercise HireOps flows. grep for sibling product nouns (pellmoor, threadline, bazaar, docketlight, torquebay, boardloom, colderwater, gridforge, patchpad, ridgeline, medcare, medledger, orbital, oriel, drawbill, coursemark, expenseflow, utilibill, vacancy, storefront) across the frozen task returned no leakage (only the ordinary word 'claims' at hireops_rules.md:12). Template placeholders (CHANGE_ME) are all replaced. Domain plan: task.toml:14-15 provenance 'Adapted from the supplied HireOps task as a recruiting workspace' and arena_slice 'recruiting-hiring-operations'; the domain was supplied by the assignment, and no separate suite domain-allocation document exists in the workspace that this conflicts with. Clone check against closest sibling projects/pellmoor-job-pipeline (same recruiting domain): shared mechanics are limited to no-skip stage moves (Pellmoor hiring-rules.md:3-4), a capacity limit, an all-or-nothing batch and stale-revision refusal. Pellmoor's core is panels with 1-5 scores, assessment versioning/invalidation, opening reservation at offer, d3 funnel derived from stage history, durable actor-scoped retry receipts and batch-offer review/preview; none of those appear in HireOps. HireOps's core (manual ordering, undo, live non-disruptive updates, recruiter-candidate conversations with unread/seen/drafts, candidate portal with wording and redaction) is absent from Pellmoor. Criterion id sets share no flows beyond the generic move/stale/capacity/batch family, and even there the rules differ (Pellmoor capacity is offer+hired openings with only the hiring manager moving; HireOps capacity is Interview places with recruiter/manager split and undo). Against projects/threadline-chat (paging preserving position, per-user unread), HireOps's conversation model is a two-party staff/candidate thread attached to an application with seen marks and candidate-only visibility, not channels/threads/reactions/pins/webhooks. Neither sibling is a nouns-swapped source. Adversarial view: a reviewer could argue two recruiting tasks in one suite is redundant; this is overlap of domain, not of flows/criteria, and the row's defect definition (same flows, same criteria, renamed entities) is not met. No runtime evidence is needed for this row.
